第49章 偷得浮生半日闲-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

“先生可以在正义值商城中兑换脑波记忆读取仪的外部设备适配升级包，该升级包可完成与目标设备的系统层对接。”

正义值商城。

顾承安没急着打开商城页面翻来翻去，直奔主题。

“多少钱？”

“5000正义值。”

顾承安眉毛挑了一下。

账户余额12355，扣掉5000，还剩7355。

五千块买个升级包，说贵吧，又不是买不起；说便宜吧，要好几个A通才换得来。可正义值这东西又不是存银行，放着还能生利息不成？

关键在于——这玩意儿一旦适配成功，后续效率提升是指数级的。

相当于花五千给自己的办案工具装了个涡轮增压。

“确认兑换。”

【兑换成功。正义值余额：7355。】

痛快。

“这个升级包怎么用？”

“需等待脑波记忆读取仪完成升级后，将该升级包植入先生的智能眼镜，届时系统会自动引导安装流程。”

“等等——”

“你的意思是，天珠没升级完，这东西还装不上？”

“是的，先生。适配升级包需要基于脑波记忆读取仪2.0版本的数据协议运行，当前设备仍在升级中，协议尚未生成。”

顾承安沉默了。

低头看了看手里还没捂热的智能眼镜，又瞅了瞅系统空间里的天珠，再瞄了一眼刚蒸发的5000正义值。

万事俱备，只欠天珠。

花了钱，用不上，还得干等。

这种感觉，跟双十一付完尾款蹲快递一模一样。

他深吸一口气，把智能眼镜放回收纳盒，盖好盖子，动作轻柔——毕竟是花了大价钱的东西，虽然现在跟块玻璃片没什么区别。

行，今天就当休息日。

正准备瘫回沙发，忽然瞥见系统空间角落里窝着一坨黄色之物。

黄团外卖服。

上次执行任务穿的，塞进空间就忘了。再不洗，下回穿出去怕不是自带生化武器效果。

从空间取出来，塞进洗衣机，按下启动键。

坐回沙发，顺手摸起菊花手机，脑子里忽然蹦出一件事——黄团账户里上个月的跑腿钱，还没提呢。

"Sir, you can redeem the brainwave memory reader's external device adaptation upgrade package in the Justice Value Mall. This upgrade package can complete system-level docking with the target device."

Justice Value Mall.

Gu Chengan didn't rush to open the mall page, flipped through it, and went straight to the topic.

"How much?"

"5000 justice value."

Gu Chengan raised his eyebrows.

The account balance is 12,355, after deducting 5,000, there is still 7,355 left.

Five thousand yuan to buy an upgrade package is expensive, but it’s not unaffordable; it’s cheap, and it takes several A-level generalists to buy it.But the value of justice is not something that can only be deposited in a bank, where it can still earn interest, right?

The key is that once this thing is successfully adapted, the subsequent efficiency improvement will be exponential.

It's equivalent to spending five thousand to install a turbocharger on your case-handling tools.

"Confirm exchange."

[Redeem successful.Justice value balance: 7355.】

Happy.

"How to use this upgrade package?"

"You need to wait for the brainwave memory reader to complete the upgrade, and then implant the upgrade package into your smart glasses. The system will automatically guide the installation process."

"Wait-"

"You mean, the Dzi Beads haven't been upgraded yet, so this thing can't be installed?"

"Yes, sir. The adaptation upgrade package needs to run based on the brainwave memory reader version 2.0 data protocol. The current device is still being upgraded and the protocol has not yet been generated."

Gu Chengan was silent.

He looked down at the smart glasses that were still warm in his hands, then at the Dzi beads in the system space, and then at the 5000 justice value that had just evaporated.

Everything is ready, all that is needed is the Dzi Beads.

You spend money, you can’t use it, you have to wait.

This feeling is exactly the same as squatting for express delivery after paying the final payment on Double Eleven.

He took a deep breath, put the smart glasses back into the storage box, closed the lid, and moved gently - after all, it was something that cost a lot of money, although it was no different from a piece of glass now.

Okay, let's take today as a day off.

Just as he was about to collapse back on the sofa, he suddenly caught a glimpse of a yellow thing nestled in the corner of the system space.

Huangtuan takeout service.

I wore it on my last mission, stuffed it into the space and forgot about it.If you don't wash it, I'm afraid it won't have the effect of a biochemical weapon the next time you wear it.

Take it out of the space, stuff it into the washing machine, and press the start button.

Sitting back on the sofa, I picked up Daisy's phone and something suddenly popped into my mind - the money for last month's errands in Huang Tuan's account hadn't been mentioned yet.
